about_short_description.short_description: Arcion is a cloud-native, zero-code data mobility platform to help deploy high-performance, real-time data pipelines.

product.name: Databricks Data Intelligence Platform
product.description: A platform for ingesting, transforming, and processing batch and streaming data with automated infrastructure management.

product.name: Delta Live Tables
product.description: A framework for building ETL and ML pipelines on batch or streaming data with automated operational complexities.

product.name: Databricks Workflows
product.description: A service for orchestrating data, analytics, and AI workloads with deep integration for reliability and monitoring.

product.name: Photon
product.description: A next-generation data processing engine compatible with Apache Spark APIs for improved performance and scalability.

product.name: Unity Catalog
product.description: Provides governance for data and AI assets, with support for Delta Sharing for secure data sharing across organizations.

product.name: Delta Lake
product.description: An open source storage format that enhances data reliability through ACID transactions and scalable metadata handling.
